full_prompt_en: A square digital science-fiction illustration centers a heavily armored warrior in dark weathered green within a towering industrial hall. The figure faces forward and fills most of the frame from the helmet to the lower torso, with enormous rounded shoulder plates extending almost to both side edges. A spiked bronze halo-like metal ring rises behind the helmet, giving the central silhouette a ceremonial and mechanical force. The small faceplate sits deep inside a thick collar and contains dark vents, a grille, and two glowing amber points. Across the breastplate, worn gold emblems and circular mechanical fittings interrupt the green painted armor. Scrapes, chips, and tarnished edges expose warmer metal beneath the paint, while rivets and seams make each plate feel heavy and assembled. Both thick arms hang forward and end in large articulated gauntlets near the lower corners. The lower body disappears into pale dust or light, so the upper armor bears the visual weight. Behind the warrior, narrow columns, pipes, and hanging mechanical details recede into a warm brown chamber; they remain detailed but less strongly contrasted than the foreground suit. Light filters from above and slightly behind, touching the metal spikes and shoulders with muted gold while the helmet recess stays dark. Subtle haze separates the dominant figure from the crowded architecture without flattening its hard surfaces. The composition is frontal and nearly symmetrical, with a palette of olive green, antique brass, soot brown, and small ember highlights. Its overall effect is monumental, worn, and ominously ceremonial.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形数字科幻插画把一位重甲战士置于高耸的工业大厅中央，其盔甲为深绿色且布满旧痕。人物正面朝向观者，从头盔到下半身甲占据画面大部，巨大的圆肩甲几乎伸到左右边缘。带尖刺的青铜色金属环从头盔后升起，让中央剪影兼具仪式感和机械力量。小小的面甲深陷在厚实领圈中，能见到暗色气孔、格栅和两点发亮的琥珀色。胸甲上，磨损的金色徽记与圆形机械构件打断绿色漆面。刮痕、崩口和失去光泽的边缘露出漆下较暖的金属，铆钉与接缝让每块甲片显得沉重而拼装成形。两只厚重手臂向前垂下，末端的大型关节手甲落在画面下角附近。下半身消失于浅色尘雾或光线中，使上半身盔甲承担视觉重量。战士身后，狭窄立柱、管道和悬挂的机械细节退入暖棕色大厅；它们细密，却没有前景盔甲那样强的反差。光从上方并略从后方滤入，以暗金色擦亮金属尖刺与肩部，头盔内凹处则保持黑暗。轻微薄雾将主导人物与拥挤的建筑分开，却没有抹平其硬质表面。构图正面而近乎对称，配色是橄榄绿、旧黄铜、烟灰棕和少量余烬般的亮色，整体效果宏大、残旧且带有不祥的仪式感。
style_prompt_en: The image is a dense digital fantasy illustration with massive assembled volumes, hard beveled edges, and elaborate metallic surface wear. Dark olive and soot brown form the structural base, interrupted by aged brass and very small amber lights. Chips, seams, rivets, and layered plates give broad shapes a tangible scale, while fine background structures fade into warm atmospheric haze. A near-symmetrical central mass dominates the frame, and radial or vertical details behind it reinforce a ceremonial rhythm. Light from above catches projecting contours, leaving recessed portions almost black. The overall look is monumental and grim, with intricate texture serving the weight and depth of the larger forms.
style_prompt_zh: 图像是一种密集的数字幻想插画，以巨大的拼装体积、坚硬的倒角边缘和繁复的金属磨损为特征。深橄榄绿与烟灰棕构成结构基底，陈旧黄铜色和极少的琥珀光点穿插其间。崩口、接缝、铆钉与层叠片面让宽大的形状有了可触的尺度，细密背景结构则退入暖色空气薄雾。近乎对称的中央体量主导画面，后方放射状或竖向细节加强仪式性的节奏。上方光线抓住凸起轮廓，内凹部分几乎留在黑色里。整体观感宏大而阴沉，繁复肌理服务于大形体的重量与纵深。
theme_en: An armored science-fiction warrior in a weathered green suit
theme_zh: 身着斑驳绿色装甲的科幻战士
name: Warhammer 40,000
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
